detail.longDescription: I was recently worried about a # flutter app I'm building where it looked like a # screenReader would be entirely unable to read the app. Apparently there's a hidden button visible to the screen reader that loads accessibility trees for non-sighted users. With # vibeCoding and # agenticai speeding up # softwareDev we need to be mindful of those who were previously ignored as too much trouble or too expensive to support. # accessibility # webDev # prohuman # a11y
